mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.account (id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, account_no, account_type, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{memberId}, #{accountNo}, #{accountType}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loyalty.member WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND id = #{memberId})

SELECT id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, account_no, account_type, status, opened_at, closed_at FROM loyalty.account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY opened_at LIMIT 1
